fixes.explanation: Family is a sweet guess, friend, but it didn't make this list. The LORD names the wise man in his wisdom, the strong man in his strength and the wealthy man in his riches (Jeremiah 9:23). Three men, three things to brag about, and not one of them is family. Nice swing, though.

Name is a fair guess, friend, but it's not what the verse says. The LORD says the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart (Jeremiah 9:26). Heart, not name. Easy to mix up when you're swinging fast, and I've done the same with a cookie tray.

Speech, baker? I love the creativity, but it's not in the verse. The LORD says the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart (Jeremiah 9:26). Heart is the word that goes in the blank. Keep that one in your apron pocket.

A priest feels like a natural pick, friend. But no priest steps up in this passage. The LORD is the One who answers why the land is destroyed (Jeremiah 9:13), and He doesn't need anybody to explain it for Him.
Dagon isn't in this verse, friend. Here the LORD says they followed the stubbornness of their hearts and “…gone after the Baals…” (Jeremiah 9:14). The Baals are the name to hold onto.
The golden calf isn't in Jeremiah 9, baker. The LORD says they followed the stubbornness of their hearts and “…gone after the Baals…” (Jeremiah 9:14). That's the name to hold onto here.

Yes, baker. The LORD says He will scatter them “…among the nations that neither they nor their fathers have known…” (Jeremiah 9:16). Not just nations they hadn't known, but nations their fathers hadn't known either.

Tents are a nice picture, baker, but Midian isn't named in this verse. The LORD says He will scatter them among nations that neither they nor their fathers have known (Jeremiah 9:16). Those are the nations to remember here.

I wish it said that, friend. But the LORD says the corpses will fall like newly cut grain behind the reaper, “…with no one to gather it.” (Jeremiah 9:22). No one is there to gather them. That's a heavy line.
